```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
ScenarioConfig <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "runScenarios.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
INPUT_ID <- as.character(ScenarioConfig$InputID)
SCENARIO_P <- as.numeric(ScenarioConfig$P)
if (length(INPUT_ID) != 1L || !nzchar(INPUT_ID) ||
    length(SCENARIO_P) != 1L || !is.finite(SCENARIO_P)) {
  stop("scenarios.response: invalid scenario family contract.", call. = FALSE)
}
PathResponse <- file.path(
  root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv"
)
PathUnits <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json")
PathSourceMeta <- file.path(
  root, "data", "gmsp", INPUT_ID, sprintf("%s.json", INPUT_ID)
)
if (any(!file.exists(c(PathResponse, PathUnits, PathSourceMeta)))) {
  stop("scenarios.response: required scenario products are missing.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
.SCENARIO_UNITS <- jsonlite::read_json(PathUnits, simplifyVector = TRUE)
.SCENARIO_META <- jsonlite::read_json(PathSourceMeta, simplifyVector = TRUE)
if (!"ppa" %in% names(.SCENARIO_UNITS) ||
    !"TargetUnits" %in% names(.SCENARIO_META)) {
  stop("scenarios.response: incomplete acceleration-unit contract.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
if (!identical(as.character(.SCENARIO_UNITS$ppa), "g") ||
    !identical(as.character(.SCENARIO_META$TargetUnits), "mm")) {
  stop("scenarios.response: unsupported acceleration-unit bridge.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
G <- 9806.65
SCENARIO_RESPONSE <- data.table::fread(
  PathResponse,
  select = c("ScenarioID", "D", "MIC", "P", "RecordID", "OCID", "PGA")
)
AUX <- SCENARIO_RESPONSE[, .(N = uniqueN(RecordID)), by = ScenarioID]
if (!nrow(AUX) || AUX[, uniqueN(N)] != 1L || AUX[, any(!is.finite(N) | N < 1L)]) {
  stop("scenarios.response: scenarios have inconsistent realization counts.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
SCENARIO_N <- unique(AUX$N)
SCENARIO_M <- data.table::uniqueN(SCENARIO_RESPONSE$ScenarioID)
rm(AUX)
if (!exists("COMPONENT_LABELS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  COMPONENT_LABELS <- c(
    H1 = "principal horizontal H1",
    H2 = "orthogonal horizontal H2",
    UP = "vertical UP"
  )
}
if (!exists("TABS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  TABS <- c(H1 = "H1", H2 = "H2", UP = "UP")
}
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste(
    "Exact peak particle acceleration of the generated %s realizations. The",
    "matrix contains %s source histories and %s $D$--$Q$ conditions at",
    "predictive level $p=%s$; each cell represents one scenario and source-",
    "history combination. Columns are ordered by $D$ and then $Q$, and the",
    "common history order is retained across H1, H2, and UP. The color scale",
    "is logarithmic, and the interactive label",
    "reports the exact PPA in g. These are absolute peaks of the generated",
    "accelerograms, not predictions from the PPA model. All individual values",
    "are shown."
  )
}
if (!exists("X_AXIS", inherits = FALSE)) X_AXIS <- "Scenario condition"
if (!exists("Y_AXIS", inherits = FALSE)) Y_AXIS <- "Source history"
if (!exists("SERIES_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) SERIES_LABEL <- "PPA [g]"
if (!exists("TOOLTIP_FORMAT", inherits = FALSE)) {
  TOOLTIP_FORMAT <- paste0(
    "Scenario: <b>{point.scenario}</b><br>",
    "D: <b>{point.d} m</b> | Q (MIC): <b>{point.q} kg</b><br>",
    "Record identifier: <b>{point.record}</b> | Direction: <b>{point.component}</b><br>",
    "PPA: <b>{point.ppa} g</b>"
  )
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

#| label: fig-scenarios-response-h1
#| fig-cap: !expr sprintf(CAP, COMPONENT_LABELS[["H1"]], SCENARIO_N, SCENARIO_M, formatC(SCENARIO_P, format = "f", digits = 2L))
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
COMPONENT <- "H1"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "scenarios.response.R"))
PLOT

rm(
  CAP, COMPONENT, COMPONENT_LABELS, G, INPUT_ID, PLOT, PathResponse,
  PathSourceMeta, PathUnits, SCENARIO_M, SCENARIO_N, SCENARIO_P,
  SCENARIO_RESPONSE, SERIES_LABEL, ScenarioConfig, TABS, TOOLTIP_FORMAT,
  X_AXIS, Y_AXIS, .SCENARIO_META, .SCENARIO_UNITS
